outcome: negative predictive value of questionnaire-based screening
cohort: Women admitted for delivery at a single center between April 22 and May 25, 2020.
finding: While the rate of positive PCR results did not significantly differ between questionnaire-positive and questionnaire-negative groups, the high number needed to screen suggests questionnaire-based testing is a reasonable, easy-to-implement strategy in low COVID-19 incidence areas for resource allocation.
